timestampContract.overlap: UNKNOWN unless same-clock sequence proves order

apiContract.totality: every entrypoint returns a tri-state receipt and never raises
apiContract.objectEntrypointValidation: full runtime type, enum, range, and identity validation

endpointProfiles.rule: one profile is one documented endpoint response schema, not a transport family

intervalIdentity.fixedDurationDeclaration: must equal the frozen step duration
intervalIdentity.calendarDurationDeclaration: must be an exact 28..31 day month
intervalIdentity.calendarEdges: open and exclusive end must be local month starts under the declared zone

fixedPhase.subdayAndDaily: local epoch grid under the declared zone

clockChain.availabilityEvidenceRequired: evidence id and SHA-256 digest for every non-null availability clock
clockChain.availabilityAtDecision: inclusive only when order is proven

intervalContract.streamEventClock: WS event time is supplied and is not required to follow the close
intervalContract.restAndArchiveEventClock: forbidden; no exchange emission clock is invented
intervalContract.streamFinalFlag: source x must be true; missing is UNKNOWN
intervalContract.restAndArchiveFinalFlag: forbidden; it cannot pretend to be source x
intervalContract.completenessProof: availability must be proven at or after the exclusive end

feedContract.FUNDING: settled USD-M REST funding history only
feedContract.CURRENT_EXCHANGE_INFO: current exchange-info snapshot, effective prospectively from observed receipt
feedContract.CURRENT_FUNDING_INFO: current funding-info snapshot, effective prospectively from observed receipt

joinContract.selectionClock: latest provable semantic event among records available by decision
joinContract.identicalDuplicate: collapse only when payload, endpoint, semantic clocks, availability clock, availability basis, and availability evidence are identical; receipt all record IDs
joinContract.sameEffectivePayloadConflict: UNKNOWN even when same-clock sequences differ

coexistence.causallyPresentAndContradictoryOrUnplace: UNKNOWN even with a valid predecessor
ignorableWithValidPredecessor: provably stale semantic event or receipt
provably partial nonfinal or pre-end interval

outcomes.VALID: every required feed and clock chain is complete, fresh, coherent, and definitely ordered
outcomes.UNKNOWN: missing, stale, ambiguous, unavailable, or contradictory evidence
outcomes.INVALID: malformed contract or definite causal-policy violation

proofContract.fixtureReplay: every hostile fixture is evaluated twice
proofContract.focusedTestExecution: verifier runs the frozen focused pytest file and requires exit zero
proofContract.focusedTestSentinel: exact executed call-phase count and deterministic node-id/outcome SHA-256
proofContract.pytestEnvironment: PYTEST_ADDOPTS and PYTEST_PLUGINS removed; plugin autoload and conftest loading disabled; dedicated config and explicit sentinel plugin used
proofContract.focusedTestOutput: not claimed or hash-bound because timing text is nondeterministic
proofContract.caps: JSON bytes, requirement count, and observation count are exercised by the focused test
